correctness.rationale: One step has multiplier R_z(u)=1−z+z²u. Independence across pairs makes H^k the even-index second-moment factor, and the first stage of the next pair adds the fixed finite factor g=E R_z² at odd indices. For the squared multipliers A,B, layer-cake integration of joint survival probabilities yields the lower bound using max(P(A>s)+P(B>t)−1,0) at every s,t. Opposite quantiles realize that bound simultaneously; continuous joint survival functions and the nonnegative integrand of the difference also justify the stated uniqueness at the magnitude level. For z≤1 the multiplier is monotone and nonnegative, so complementary stages minimize. For z>1, the distance |U−a| has density 2 below a and 1 above a; at paired distance w≤a the two branches a±w must be chosen equally, while only the plus branch is used for w>a. This recovers uniform V and reaches the optimal joint magnitudes. Integration on [0,2a], [2a,1−2a] and [1−2a,1] gives the polynomial, with a≤1/4 and a vanishing middle interval at z=2. The iid bound g²<1 covers 0<z≤4/3 by the strictly increasing cubic for (g−1)/z. Above 4/3 the lower quantile branch has derivative zt>0 for t>0 and the upper branch derivative is at least 3−4/z; continuity at the moving branch boundary gives strict increase in z for each interior t. The quantile grows as order z² on an interior t band as z→∞, so H diverges. H(2)=4/5 proves the unique crossing is beyond 2; H=1 does not imply decay for nonzero initial data. Both quoted decimals and z=2 comparisons were checked exactly to the stated precision.
residual_risks: Only the stated real scalar test equation, fixed z, and independent identically distributed pairs are covered. Intra-pair nonuniqueness is allowed, and a new pair law may be selected for each z.

value.rationale: The scalar test equation is the usual benchmark for negative-axis stability. Two-step dependence at unchanged one-step marginals gives mean-square decay in a regime not attained even by raw antithetic pairing or deterministic midpoint, with a realizable optimizer and an exact exclusion of all other iid-pair laws beyond the frontier. This is a structural regime change and a baseline for comparisons of couplings, not an isolated decimal refinement.
residual_risks: No conclusion for multidimensional or nonlinear systems, longer-range couplings, strong accuracy, work efficiency, or almost-sure stability.
